Creating a widget

PDF RSS

A widget holds your parts. Use CreateWidget or see the API reference.

Note

Widget names are unique per Region.
They cannot be changed.

Steps

  1. Open the console.

  2. Choose Create.

    • Pick a size.
    • Pick a colour.
{
    "WidgetName": "my-widget",
    "Size": 3
}

Request parameters

WidgetName

The widget's name.

Type: String

Size

Number of parts.

LimitValue
Widgets per account100 | soft

JavaScript is disabled.
